resources.string: Tables, fenced code and advanced embeds open as Markdown so their structure remains intact.

This exposes this phone’s recognizer over HTTP to clients on your network. Watch recording does not need it. Choose a port (usually 8060), check GET http://phone-ip:8060/status, and submit multipart audio to POST /transcribe.
Transcribe keeps the spoken language. Translate uses Whisper to produce English. This is unrelated to creating tasks in a planner.

This is a phone dictation shortcut. Select Neo as the Android digital assistant, then hold the power button. Samsung side-key assignment is configured separately. These animations belong to the assistant overlay; recording visuals are configured under App behavior.

For push-to-talk, enable Neo under Android Accessibility. Hold the selected volume button while speaking and release to finish. Voice-keyboard mode uses a double press of Volume Down to dictate into a text field. Power-key interception depends on the device.
Identity is only for external PiMax services. Local notes and transcription do not need an account. Auth uses the same server host on port 8100, GET /api/whoami.

This integrates with a separate PiMax Tasks server, not a built-in planner. Set your host, connect through Wi-Fi/VPN, and test it. Default port: 8058. GET /api/health checks availability; POST /api/tasks takes title and source=whisper. Enabling sends transcripts as tasks. Leave off without the server.

Habits require a separate Streak Tracker on the same host, port 8055. GET /api/health checks it; POST /api/whisper-hook receives recognized text. Habit names and commands are configured on your server. This is not a local habit database.
This is an external command processor on port 8073, not the Android assistant. It requires GET /api/health and POST /api/whisper-hook and receives transcripts for command processing.

Recommended: %1$s for this language and memory budget. Models are multilingual: Tiny is faster, Base generally helps non-English speech, Small needs more memory. Your selected model is never changed automatically.
A silent notification disappears when finished. Note-list status stays visible. Turning this off lets Android limit long background work.
Permanently delete the selected notes and audio? This cannot be undone.
Move the selected notes and audio to trash?
Server not configured or user not identified
Text cleanup requires an external LLM Gateway. LOCAL includes Whisper recognition, not this LLM processor.
Gateway supports transcription here. Select LOCAL or GPU Server for translation.

Optional for local notes and recognition. Enter your server URL including http:// or https://. This host uses ports 8058 for Tasks, 8055 for habits, 8073 for the remote assistant, and 8100 for auth. Those services must be deployed separately and reachable over Wi-Fi/VPN.
Enter a complete URL, for example http://server.local:7860
